name: playwright-fast
description: Persistent, contract-driven Playwright automation for low-latency Codex browser work.

interface.shortDescription: Run browser flows through a persistent Chromium runtime.
interface.longDescription: Exposes run, reset, and status tools backed by one reusable Playwright browser, with visible nested schemas, forgiving common action syntax, SPA-aware navigation, scoped locators, popup adoption, response capture, credential-aware CORS mocks, request-failure diagnostics, storage fixtures, and a 30-minute idle TTL.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run this browser flow with one compact Playwright Fast contract.
